issues: The 'Made with Emergent' floating badge in the preview environment overlaps the bottom-right corner where QuickCreateFAB lives (bottom-5 right-5, z-40). In the preview the badge intercepts pointer events on the FAB toggle. This is PREVIEW-ONLY — the Emergent badge is injected by the preview shell and will NOT exist in production deployment, so this is not a launch blocker. If desired, FAB could be raised to bottom-20 to clear the badge in preview.

critical_code_review_comments: test_iteration_19.test_change_plan_owner leaves the live demo company's subscription.plan set to 'pro' (last line at 185 posts {plan:'pro'} without resetting). Future iterations or QA users hitting the live preview will see plan='pro' instead of the documented 'business' baseline. Add a teardown that resets to 'business' (the post-migration default) at end of the test, or use a non-demo seeded company for plan-change tests.

QuickCreateFAB.jsx data-testid naming is inconsistent with conventional pattern — uses 'fab-toggle' + 'fab-{key}' while review spec/docs reference 'fab-trigger' + 'fab-action-{key}'. Either align the code with the docs or update the docs. Both work, but mismatch risks future test breakage.

Subscription.jsx Switch-plan flow currently shows generic 'Switch to X' CTA on all paid plans regardless of whether Stripe is configured — when Stripe price_id is missing the backend returns 400 (which is fine), but UX would benefit from disabling the CTA in dev-mode and showing 'Stripe not configured' hint instead of a 400 toast.

SuperTenants.jsx — the duplicated <option> entries (now fixed) would have caused React to log a 'Encountered two children with the same key' warning. Recommend wiring options from the same PLANS catalog constant the backend uses (single source of truth) instead of hard-coding option lists in the JSX — prevents future drift like this.

FAB at fixed bottom-5 right-5 conflicts with the preview environment's 'Made with Emergent' badge (also bottom-right). Move FAB to bottom-20 or right-20 to coexist cleanly, OR leave as-is for production where the badge is absent.

rca of the issue: RCA — SuperTenants plan-filter duplicate options: When main agent updated the dropdown from the old 4-tier (starter/lite/pro/enterprise) to the new 5-tier (basic/team/business/pro/enterprise), they appended the new options but forgot to remove the trailing 'pro'/'enterprise' lines from the previous taxonomy. Result: two identical <option value='pro'> and <option value='enterprise'> entries. Fix: deleted lines 109-110 of /app/frontend/src/pages/SuperTenants.jsx; dropdown now renders 6 options exactly. RCA — demo subscription showing 'pro' in API: test_iteration_19.TestSubscription.test_change_plan_owner posts {plan:'pro'} to /api/subscription/change-plan against the live demo company and does not reset it back. After the pytest run, the live demo state is 'pro' not 'business'. Mitigation: reset the document manually OR add a teardown fixture. Neither is a production bug — strictly test data pollution. Migration 0003 itself is correct (proven by migrated_from='pro' marker on the document).
